starting-out-talking-to-lucien.speaker: Lucien
starting-out-talking-to-lucien.text: I seek a hero to go on an important mission!
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I require the Staff of Armadyl. But if you wish to seek it for me, you must free up some inventory space so that I can give you what you need.

starting-out-talking-to-lucien.speaker: Lucien
starting-out-talking-to-lucien.text: I require the Staff of Armadyl. It is in the deserted Temple of Ikov, near Hemenster, north east of here.

starting-out-talking-to-lucien.speaker: Lucien
starting-out-talking-to-lucien.text: Take care hero! There is a dangerous monster somewhere in the temple!

options.text: Why can't you get it yourself?

steps.player: Why can't you get it yourself?

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: The guardians of the Staff of Armadyl fear me!

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: They have set up a magical barrier which even my power cannot overcome!
Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it. Your combat level is also lower than the recommended level of 45.

steps.prompt: Start the Temple of Ikov quest?

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: It's not as easy as it sounds. The monster can only be killed with a weapon of ice. There are many other dangers.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I shall give you a pendant. Without it you will not be able to enter the Chamber of Fear.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: Here is my pendant. Now, I cannot stay here much longer. Meet me in my house, across the river south-east from Edgeville. It is next to the so-called Grand Exchange.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I see you are the mercenary type.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I will reward you well if you bring me the staff.

steps.prompt: Start the Temple of Ikov quest?

options.text: Oh no! Sounds far too dangerous!

steps.player: Oh no! Sounds far too dangerous!

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: Wimp! Call yourself a hero?! My daughter is more of a hero than you!

starting-out-talking-to-lucien-again.speaker: Lucien
starting-out-talking-to-lucien-again.text: I told you not to meet me here again! Soon I will go to my house, across the river south-east from Edgeville. It is next to the so-called Grand Exchange.
If the player lost the pendant:

steps.player: I've lost the pendant you gave me.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: Imbecile!

starting-out-talking-to-lucien-again.text: If the player still has the pendant:

steps.player: Sorry! Can you remind me of my mission?

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: My patience grows thin hero!

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I need the Staff of Armadyl. It's in the Temple of Ikov, near Hemenster, north east of here.

inside-the-dungeon-going-downstairs-with.text: It's a bit dark down here! You decide not to venture far.

inside-the-dungeon-opening-the-north-gat.text: As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!

inside-the-dungeon-crossing-the-bridge-w.text: The bridge gives way under your weight!
Good thing that lava was shallow!

inside-the-dungeon-using-lever-on-lever-.text: You fit the lever into the bracket.

inside-the-dungeon-pulling-the-lever.text: You hear the clunking of some hidden machinery.

steps.text: You find a trap on the lever! You disable the trap.
You find nothing.

inside-the-dungeon-pulling-the-lever-wit.text: The player falls down the trapdoor onto some spikes, taking 20 damage.

steps.text: You found some ice arrows!
You search the chest, but find nothing.

inside-the-dungeon-opening-door-in-the-f.text: The Fire Warrior casts fire bolt and knocks the player back from the door.

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-the-fire-w.speaker: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-the-fire-w.text: Who dares to enter the Temple of Ikov!

steps.speaker: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
steps.text: Pathetic fool! Prepare to die!
The Fire Warrior attacks.

steps.speaker: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
steps.text: I haven't seen a pilgrim for thousands of years!

steps.speaker: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
steps.text: Temple is closed!

inside-the-dungeon-attacking-the-fire-wa.speaker: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
inside-the-dungeon-attacking-the-fire-wa.text: Your puny weapons do nothing against me human! Come back when you can give me a real fight!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda.speaker: Winelda
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda.text: Hehe! We see you're in a pickle!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda.speaker: Winelda
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda.text: Wants to be getting over the nasty lava do we?

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Hehe! Ye'll come back! They always come back!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Mocking us are we? Clever one aren't we?

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: I'm knowing some magic trickesses! I could get over easy as that!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Don't tell them! They always come! They pester poor Winelda!

steps.player: If you're such a great witch, get me over!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: See! They pester Winelda!

steps.player: I can do something for you!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Good! Don't pester! Help!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Get Winelda 20 limpwurt roots for my pot.

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Then we shows them some magic!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: I'm knowing some magic trickesses! I could get over easy as that!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Don't tell them! They always come! They pester poor Winelda!

steps.player: If you're such a great witch, get me over!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: See! They pester Winelda!

steps.player: I can do something for you!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Good! Don't pester! Help!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Get Winelda 20 limpwurt roots for my pot.

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Then we shows them some magic!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-ag.text: If the player has no limpwurt roots:

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Have you got roots for poor Winelda?

steps.player: How many did you need again?

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: We needs 20 Limpwurt roots for pot.

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-ag.text: If the player has 1-19 limpwurt roots:

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Have you got roots for poor Winelda?

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: We needs 20 rooteses!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-ag.text: If the player has 20 limpwurt roots:

steps.player: I've got you the limpwurt roots!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Good! Good! My potion is nearly ready! Bubble, bubble, toil and trouble!

steps.speaker: Winelda
steps.text: Now we shows them ours magic! Hold on tight!
Winelda takes the limpwurt roots and teleports the player across the lava.

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-af.player: Hi again. Could you do the honours again please?

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-af.speaker: Winelda
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-winelda-af.text: Certainly! We helps those that helps poor Winelda!
Winelda teleports the player across the lava.

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.text: Thou is a foul agent of Lucien! Such an agent must die!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.text: Thou hast ventured deep into the tunnels, you have reached the temple of our master. It is many ages since a pilgrim has come here.

options.text: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.player: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: We are the guardians of the staff, our fathers were guardians and our fathers' fathers before that. Why dost thou seek it?

options.text: Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!

steps.player: Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Thou art working for that spawn of evil?! Fool! You must be cleansed to save your soul!

options.text: How dare you call me a fool!

steps.player: How dare you call me a fool! I will work for whom I want!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: We must cleanse the temple!
The guardian attacks the player.

options.text: I just thought of something I must do!

steps.player: I just thought of something I must do!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: An agent of evil cannot be allowed to leave!
The guardian attacks the player.

options.text: You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.

steps.player: You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.

steps.text: The guardian splashes holy water over you.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: You have been cleansed!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Lucien must not get hold of the staff! He would become too powerful!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Hast thou come across the undead necromancer? It was he that raised an army of the undead against Varrock a generation ago. If you know where he is you can help us defeat him.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: So he is close by?

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: He must be gaining in power again. If you can defeat him he will be banished from this plane for a while. You will need this pendant to attack him.

options.text: No! I shall not turn against my employer!

steps.player: No! I shall not turn against my employer!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Fool! You will die for your sins!
The guardian attacks the player.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Linger a while and be at peace.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: The staff is sacred! You will not have it!
The guardian attacks the player.

options.text: I collect rare and powerful artefacts.

steps.player: I collect rare and powerful artefacts.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Your worldly greed has darkened your soul!
The guardian attacks the player.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: I may be a fool but I will not step aside!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Only members of our order are allowed to handle the staff.
The guardian attacks the player.

options.text: You're right, I will go now.

steps.player: You're right, I will go now.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: That is a wise decision. Stay a while and let your soul be cleansed!

options.text: What are your kind and what are you doing here?

steps.player: What are your kind and what are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: We are the Guardians of Armadyl. We have kept the temple safe for many ages. The evil in the dungeons seek what lies here. The Mahjarrat are the worst.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Armadyl is the god we serve. We have been charged with guarding his sacred arctifacts until he requires them.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Go in peace.

options.text: Someone told me there were only three gods.

steps.player: Someone told me there were only three gods. Saradomin, Zamorak and Guthix.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Saradominists. Bleh. They only acknowledge those three. There are at least twenty gods!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: They are ancient and powerful beings! They are very evil! It is said that they once dominated this plane of existence, Zamorak was supposedly of their blood. They are far fewer in number now.

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Some still have presence in this world in their liche forms. Mahjarrat such as Lucien and Azzanadra would become very powerful if they came into possession of the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.player: Did you say Lucien? It was Lucien that asked me to get the staff!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: You are a fool to be working for Lucien! Your soul must be cleansed to save you!

options.text: How dare you call me a fool!
I just thought of something I must do!
You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.
I hope you're doing a good job then!

steps.player: I hope you're doing a good job then!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Do not fear! We are devoted to our charge!

options.text: Wow! You must be really old!

steps.player: Wow! You must be really old!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: No! I am not old! My family has guarded the staff for many generations.

inside-the-dungeon-taking-the-staff-of-a.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
inside-the-dungeon-taking-the-staff-of-a.text: That is not thine to take!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-a-guardian.text: Halt! You will not leave here with the Staff of Armadyl!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-the-guardi.text: If the player lost the Armadyl pendant:

steps.player: Not yet, I've lost the pendant you gave me!

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Hurry friend! Time is against us!

inside-the-dungeon-talking-to-the-guardi.text: If the player still has the Armadyl pendant:

steps.speaker: Guardian of Armadyl
steps.text: Hurry friend! Time is against us!

inside-the-dungeon-taking-the-staff-of-a.text: You decide not to steal the staff as you have agreed to help the Guardians.

finishing-up-talking-to-lucien-near-varr.speaker: Lucien
finishing-up-talking-to-lucien-near-varr.text: Have you got the Staff of Armadyl yet?
If the player does not have the staff:
If the player has the staff:

steps.text: You give Lucien the Staff of Armadyl.

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: Muhahahhahahaha!

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I can feel the power of the staff running through me! I will be more powerful and they shall bow down to me!

steps.speaker: Lucien
steps.text: I suppose you want your reward? I shall grant you much power!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

finishing-up-attacking-lucien-without-we.speaker: Lucien
finishing-up-attacking-lucien-without-we.text: You don't want to attack me. I am your friend.
You decide not to attack Lucien. He is your friend.

finishing-up-defeating-lucien.speaker: Lucien
finishing-up-defeating-lucien.text: You have defeated me for now! I shall reappear in the North!
